author: More Perfect Union
description:
After global backlash and a new investigation from California's Attorney General, xAI put out an announcement that falls short, particularly the platform's emphasis on blocking deepfakes "in those jurisdictions where it’s illegal" and insistence on cracking down on deepfakes despite the platform rejecting reports to do just that.

This crisis exposes the consequences of Elon Musk's sole authority over what Grok features can be turned on or off, as well as oligarch control over AI implementation and social media writ large.
title: We Asked X Investors About Grok's Explicit Deepfakes

description:
Trump has long targeted Chicago, calling it the "most dangerous city in the world."
But homicides were down 30% last year, even as Trump cut crime prevention grants.
What's making crime fall? Investments in community-led violence prevention programs.
